shots.name: d_day_toast_folded
shots.js: t.ui.help(false); t.ui.toast('S6.bld.sunyang_zhengdian'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1800)); return t.ui.state().places;

shots.name: d_day_toast_open
shots.js: t.ui.unfold(true); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500)); return t.ui.state().places;

shots.name: d_day_journal_city
shots.js: t.ui.discover(['r:shizijie','r:chengmen','S6.bld.sunyang_zhengdian','S6.fig.storyteller_3822','S6.str.square_well_2000','S5.bld.tax_office','S5.str.gate_tower','S5.str.moat_bridge','t:V5.1']); await t.ui.journal.open('S6.bld.sunyang_zhengdian'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3500)); return t.ui.journal.state();

shots.name: d_day_journal_gate
shots.js: t.ui.journal.turn(1); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500)); return t.ui.journal.state();

shots.name: d_day_journal_col
shots.js: t.ui.journal.turn(-5); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); return t.ui.journal.state();

shots.name: d_day_hud_marks
shots.js: t.ui.journal.close(); await t.hud.show(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3500)); return t.hud.stats();
